svg.title: A quick check on a photo of a skin lesion
svg.desc: HEALTH. A quick check on a photo of a skin lesion. Upload an image and a trained model classifies the lesion, served through a simple Flask web app. Built with Flask · Python · Jupyter. Click to open the repo.
